Backend Engineer - Payments Team

Full-time · Remote · Posted 3 days ago

We're looking for a backend engineer to join our payments team, working on the ledger service that reconciles transactions across four different payment processors.

What you'll do

  • Design and maintain idempotent payment reconciliation jobs
  • Partner with support on transaction disputes
  • Improve test coverage on the settlement pipeline

About the team

The payments team owns everything between checkout and settlement, including reconciliation, chargebacks, and processor failover.
